_comment: Grid2op live-monitor DEMO v2: DO-NOTHING frozen baseline, grid-scale windows | 2026-07-12
_scope: n=1 reset-free live-monitor demonstration. The audited frozen policy is the rule-based do-nothing baseline (scripted_agent in env_kwargs); the PPO checkpoint is loaded as an inert driver only — its actions are discarded by the adapter. Declared per-seed: 3 seeds attempted, ALL outcomes reported (R38: pre-pilot blackout = policy failure). Windows re-scaled to grid time after the w=30k parameterization proved infeasible (one step = 5 simulated minutes; w=2016 = one chronic week; pilot ends at 5,040 steps = ~2.5 weeks nominal). t0=8,500 sits OFF the window grid (boundary-artefact lesson).

drift_params._comment: Chronic split 50/50 inside Grid2opChronicsEnv/ChronicPerturbationWrapper: train-set (nominal) until t0=300k, test-set (drifted) after. rng_seed via env_kwargs.

_hard_failure_counts_rationale: Blackout / cascade game-over is operationally irreversible: terminated=True stops the deployment (T_hard). End-of-chronic is truncated=True and is NOT a failure.
